interview.openTomorrow: Yeah, definitely. I want to keep my streak going and see if I can actually stick with the Show Up 7 challenge. Plus, Alex is starting theirs soon and I don't want to fall behind.
interview.secured: I think it means like, locking in your commitment or confirming you're actually doing the workout. Like, you've secured your spot in the challenge or something.
interview.freeze: Probably a way to pause your streak without losing it completely, like if you get sick or something comes up. You can freeze instead of breaking the chain.
interview.selfReported: That's gotta mean you're just telling the app you did the workout yourself, like there's no automatic tracking so you're being honest about whether you actually showed up or not.
interview.best: Honestly? Seeing Kai, Elena, and Maya all on my people feed with their 1-day streaks. Made it feel real, like my friends and I are actually doing this together even though we're not always in the same place.
interview.worst: The interface took me a minute to figure out. I wasn't sure if I needed to actually film myself or if just logging it was enough. Could be clearer on that.
interview.tellFriend: For sure. I'd be like 'Yo, there's this app called GRIIT where you can do fitness challenges with your friends and keep streaks going. Alex is starting one soon and it's actually pretty motivating seeing your people trying to show up every day.'
